title: Pickaxes

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Pickaxes are a weapon class.
They can be used to mine ores, which no other type of player-weapon can do. Pickaxes formerly only hit a single target, but as of the Hearth and Home update, gained a cleaving attribute.
Their primary attack is a downward swing. They do not have a secondary attack.

full_text:
Pickaxes

Introduction. Pickaxes are a weapon class.
They can be used to mine ores, which no other type of player-weapon can do. Pickaxes formerly only hit a single target, but as of the Hearth and Home update, gained a cleaving attribute.
Their primary attack is a downward swing. They do not have a secondary attack.

Tips. • The simplest way to get your first pickaxe is to defeat the first boss to obtain the antler pickaxe.
